title: Landsat9-2instrument_H264
description: There are 2 instruments on Landsat 9 to collect all the science data. The Operational Land Imager 2 collects light, and works kind of like our eyes — or cameras — to make data-rich images. The Thermal Infrared Sensor 2 measures temperature, helping monitor plant health, fires, and more. From the series “9 Things About Landsat 9” https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/13917
keywords: Landsat, technology, infrared, NASA, USGS, earth science, Landsat-9, U.S. Geological Survey
via: the NASA Image and Video Library

transcript.text: Two Instruments That Make It All Happen
There are two instruments aboard Landsat 9.
Once in orbit, OLI-2 collects sunlight reflected off Earth’s surface.
The light passes through a set of filters,
to separate out nine specific wavelength bands,
Each band provides different pieces of information about
what is down on the surface.
The second instrument aboard Landsat 9, called TIRS-2,
or temperature signatures emitted by the Earth itself.
